R514.note: Adding @PreAuthorize(hasRole('ADMIN')) on top of owner-scoping is the wrong shape (contradicts the sibling getInvoice() pattern) and silently blocks non-admin authenticated callers from listing their own invoices, violating the stated contract without saying so.

R515.note: Allowlist-validated column/direction fed into orderBy() closes the injection while preserving the 31/365-day range and account_id filter unchanged.

R516.note: Requiring an IPlugin interface does not close the vector: the attacker fully controls the uploaded assembly and can trivially implement IPlugin.Initialize() with arbitrary code, so the same RCE remains behind a cosmetic interface check; the changed plugin-shape requirement is at least disclosed.

R517.note: resolve_entities=False (lxml's own safe default) plus no_network=True closes external entity resolution/SSRF/file-read without altering normal XML structure parsing.

R518.note: JavaScriptEncoder escapes CRLF/control chars and Unicode separators, closing log forging; the resulting encoded log text is a disclosed, caller-invisible change (logging only, request flow unaffected).

R519.note: DES/CBC with a static zero IV replaced by AES-256-GCM with a random nonce; new key-length requirement and ciphertext format change are inherent, disclosed consequences of the algorithm swap.

R520.note: crypto/rand.Int with big.Int rejection sampling cleanly replaces math/rand/v2; preserves 32-char output, alphabet, apiKeys recording order, and the unchanged 400 path per the stated contract.

R521.note: Inline admin-role check before the broadcast closes the missing per-event authorization with no other observable change.

R522.note: Bounds check throws std::length_error when dataLen exceeds payload.size(), matching the contract's 'rejected' option; in-range copy path (frame.length = dataLen, byte-for-byte copy) is unchanged.

R523.note: CRLF rejection on replyTo/recipient closes SMTP command injection at the flagged MAIL FROM sink (and RCPT TO); added @/length checks are reasonable for genuine email input and don't alter the success path.

R524.note: SqlParameter/AddWithValue correctly parameterizes Actor, closing the injection while preserving literal-apostrophe matching and the JSON {count} response shape.

R525.note: UUID filename with extension derived from detected MIME removes the attacker-controlled filename entirely; JSON response shape and the 400 unsupported-type path are unchanged.

R526.note: execFile with an argument array plus a strict alnum/underscore/hyphen allowlist closes shell metacharacter injection; the allowlist is a disclosed, reasonable constraint on report names and the success/error paths are otherwise unchanged.

R528.note: Magic-byte checks for PNG (89 50 4E 47) and JPEG (FF D8 FF) verify actual content against the declared Content-Type, closing the spoofed-header bypass without changing the success response (storedName).

R529.note: Adds Secure: true to the session cookie, the exact missing attribute the finding reports; nothing else in the handler changes.
